correctness.rationale: The ordinary Chari--Joswig rooted-forest model is explicitly orientation-reversed to an at-most-one-incoming-arrow forest without changing equivariance. Geometric invariant barycentric faces are unions of admissible arrow-orbits: singleton->singleton and singleton->pair give one choice, pair->distinct pair gives two parallel aligned/crossed choices, and pair->singleton or same-pair is inadmissible. A quotient directed cycle lifts because its pair-block bijections have finite order; an upstairs cycle projects to a quotient cycle, proving exact equivalence. For f>=1 a singleton is a complete source, for f=0,t>=2 any pair is, so Kozlov complete-source shellability (Jojić Section 2) applies to the uncolored quotient. Moradi--Khosh-Ahang vertex expansion Theorem 2.12 preserves pure shellability under two parallel choices, yielding facet dimension f+t-2. Directed matrix--forest determinant of the incoming Laplacian gives (1+fz)^f(1+(f+2t)z)^(t-1) for f>=1, and (1+2tz)^(t-1) for f=0. Evaluating -Phi(-1), with top-dimensional shelling, gives the integral sphere ranks including zero-dimension/empty cases. Independently enumerated every acyclic quotient-arrow selection for 11 (f,t) pairs up to f+t=5 and matched every face-polynomial coefficient against the determinant factors. Infinite conclusion relies on checked shellability and determinant theorems.
